62304.name: Juggernaut Drive – DMG UP
62304.SpecificEffects:
Can use the Code <skill mainSkill=62304>[Weapon Switch]</skill> up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. After taking action, if both Arms are undestroyed, can use <skill mainSkill=62304>[Weapon Switch]</skill> an additional <color=#F74848>1</color> time every <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
In combat, Enemy DMG Taken <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power, Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, and DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
